cases.name: unit_drift
cases.description: A unit reported upstream that differs from the table.

cases.name: renamed_column
cases.description: A requested column missing from the response.

cases.name: missing_block
cases.description: The requested resolution block is absent.

cases.description: The requested resolution block is absent.

cases.name: time_not_increasing
cases.description: A repeated timestamp cannot form a valid series.

cases.name: misaligned_column
cases.description: A column shorter than the time axis cannot form a valid series.

cases.name: empty_column
cases.description: A requested variable with no value at all; the message names the source.

cases.name: api_error_reason
cases.description: The reason of an HTTP 400 error payload is surfaced.

cases.name: api_error_without_reason
cases.description: An HTTP 400 whose payload has an unknown shape still raises an HTTP error.

cases.name: rate_limited
cases.description: HTTP 429; the requested wait (Retry-After) is kept.

cases.name: server_error
cases.description: HTTP 5xx is the provider's failure.

cases.name: html_instead_of_json
cases.description: A 200 answer that is not JSON (e.g. a captive portal or proxy page) is a contract error.

cases.name: html_error_page
cases.description: An HTML 5xx page: no reason can be read, the status still classifies the error.

cases.name: boolean_in_column
cases.description: A boolean is not a number (lax parsing would read true as 1.0).

cases.name: numeric_string_in_column

cases.name: column_not_a_list

cases.name: float_timestamps
